newEpisodes.title: OpenClaw Power, MacBook Simplicity: Five Days With Grok Bot
newEpisodes.note: （Substack feed全文萃取）：swyx五日實測Grok Bot vs OpenClaw對比：Grok Bot=MacBook/managed agent computer（plugin一click+OAuth登入、雲端永續電腦、跨裝置無縫、virtual browser令普通網站變automatable workflow、Update/Reset兩桿）；OpenClaw=Linux/user-owned platform（自由度大但setup overhead，OpenClaw 2.0今週推出Quick Start重用Claude Code/Codex登入+browser app+Hostinger one-click managed大幅收窄差距）；programming abstraction論（English介面+Bot做原子單元）、personification、Agentic Engineer Bot routing（visual/design→Claude Code、debug→Codex、簡單→Grok Build CLI）；安全警告「Bots係organizational boundaries唔係security boundaries」；代價：無model picker/無context控制桿、深層implementation工作唔適合、單一Bot內任務邊界模糊；結論=數碼chief of staff但短期唔會寫大部分PR

no_priors.lastEpisodeTitle: Redefining Chip Architecture with Arm CEO Rene Haas

newEpisodes.title: Redefining Chip Architecture with Arm CEO Rene Haas
newEpisodes.note: （megaphone RSS核實9/3 10:00Z+章節萃取+AGI CPU規格外圍核實）：Arm CEO Rene Haas上No Priors：CPU仍係現代運算心臟、AI唔係GPU獨腳戲。Arm由IP授權35年首度轉型賣實體晶片Arm AGI CPU（Meta lead customer+共同開發，OpenAI/Cerebras/Cloudflare launch partners）：136核Neoverse V3雙die每粒~500億電晶體TSMC 3nm、全核3.2/boost3.7GHz、TDP 300W、12通道DDR5 8800MT/s >800GB/s<100ns、96條PCIe Gen6+CXL 3.0、宣稱rack throughput >2x x86；3/24發佈即收單、2026底量產、2028先有顯著收入、股價單日+17%。話題：供應鏈瓶頸/AI縮短chip time-to-market/數據中心建設瓶頸/SoftBank槓桿資本策略/機器人機會/美國半導體製造獨立/數據中心backlash/CPU orchestration係agentic AI新瓶頸。StartupHub補充批判：冇節點性能授權細節、同NVIDIA/Apple licensee直接競爭矛盾未解，當direction唔好當roadmap。同期脈絡：OpenAI Astra+Meta Spark 1.3同週夾擊，模型/芯片/資本齊齊為agentic cloud重新排陣
